title: Dilly Dedalus
html_source: Bloom had seen Dilly here about two hours earlier. “From Butler’s monument house corner he glanced along Bachelor’s walk. Dedalus' daughter there still outside Dillon’s auctionrooms.” (From the Lestrygonians chapter.) Also, earlier in this chapter Katey Dedalus had asked, “Where’s Dilly?” –“Gone to meet father,” Maggy answered.
